title: SQL Injection in QueryBuilder orderings and raw statements
description: Dynamic user-controlled column names passed directly to QueryBuilder::orderBy() without column whitelisting or escaping can lead to SQL Injection.
recommendation: Always enforce strict whitelisting for dynamic table or column identifiers; use createNamedParameter() for values.

title: Broken Access Control via @ignorevalidation on mutating actions
description: Mutating Extbase Controller actions using @ignorevalidation or #[IgnoreValidation] allow attackers to submit crafted property payloads (Mass Assignment) or bypass domain validation.
recommendation: Never suppress validation on updateAction, deleteAction, or createAction without manual permission and ownership enforcement.

title: Stored & Reflected Cross-Site Scripting in Fluid Templates
description: Using f:format.raw() or escapeOutput='false' on user-controlled variables deactivates context-aware HTML escaping.
recommendation: Keep default Fluid escaping active. For rich HTML, filter via SanitizerBuilder or HTMLPurifier. Pass JS data via data attributes, never inline JS strings.

title: Multi-Tenant & Permission Bypass via Extbase QuerySettings
description: Disabling query settings globally via setIgnoreEnableFields(true) or setRespectStoragePage(false) exposes deleted, hidden, or foreign-tenant records to frontend queries.
recommendation: Never configure setIgnoreEnableFields(true) globally on a repository.

title: Server-Side Request Forgery via GeneralUtility::getUrl
description: Passing unvalidated, user-supplied URLs into GeneralUtility::getUrl() allows attackers to scan internal infrastructure, access metadata services (169.254.169.254), or bypass firewalls.
recommendation: Validate and whitelist protocols (https only), hostnames, and block internal IP ranges (127.0.0.1, 10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.0.0/16, 169.254.169.254).
